name: Structural Design Lab
tagline: Simulate wind and seismic action on a tower and compare 24 structural material/system alternatives.
description: Runs a 3D wind and seismic action simulation on a tower — colour-graded stress under load — checks it against serviceability gates (period, drift, peak acceleration, P-delta), and generates a comparison table across 24 material and lateral-system alternatives.

page.objective: Compare structural material and system choices for a tower against real wind/seismic action, quickly.
page.problem: Comparing structural system alternatives against wind and seismic serviceability limits is normally a slow, scheme-by-scheme engineering exercise.
page.solution: One region/material/system input runs a 3D wind and seismic simulation, checks it against the serviceability gates, and lists the same comparison across 24 alternatives.

highlights.headline: Colour-graded stress simulation feeding a 24-scheme structural comparison.
points: Animates wind-load response on the full tower model with live colour-graded axial stress.
Checks the result against serviceability gates — period, drift, peak acceleration, P-delta.
Generates a 24-row table comparing structural material and lateral-system alternatives.
